import numpy as np
def coeffs(M, dt, r, sigma):
    al = 2.0 * r / sigma ** 2
    j = np.arange(1, M, dtype=float)
    a1 = (j + 1) / j ** al - j / (j + 1) ** al
    a2 = (j + 2) / j ** al - j / (j + 2) ** al
    a3 = (j + 2) / (j + 1) ** al - (j + 1) / (j + 2) ** al
    q = a2 - a1 - a3
    p1 = np.expm1(r * dt)
    return (a2 - a1) / q - 1.0, -a2 / q - 1.0 / p1, a1 / q, p1
s = np.linspace(0.0, 4.0, 65)
g = np.maximum(1.0 - s, 0.0)
lo, ce, up, p1 = coeffs(64, 1.0 / 64, 0.1, 0.3)
assert np.allclose(nsfd_american_step(g, lo, ce, up, p1, g, 1.0, 0.0), target)
